description:
WizTree is a hard drive disk space analyser similar to WinDirStat but is MUCH faster.


- Sped up MFT file scanning and decoding
- Duplicate file detection (by name, size, date) on the File View tab is now much faster
- CSV import is now much faster, and some issues with files imported from the macOS or Linux versions of WizTree were fixed
- CSV export is now much faster
- WizTree will now appear on the new Windows 11 File Explorer context menu
- New "Rescan selected folder" option on the Tree View context menu (or Ctrl+F5, which used to rescan everything like F5): scans just the selected folder(s) - or the folders of the selected files - and updates that part of the tree and the totals, instead of rescanning everything (cancelling leaves the tree as it was)
- Zooming in/out of the treemap is now animated. The animation can be turned off via Options->Tweaks->Animate treemap zoom
- Possible UI lag when displaying scans of millions of files fixed
- MFT file import (dumped .mft files) sped up
- WizTree will now reduce thread use when scanning spinning hard drives, as too many threads cause a slow down on such devices due to the drive's read head having to physically move
- The size unit used for converting bytes to KB/MB/GB can now be set in Options->Tweaks (1024 by default, Windows style, or 1000, Mac style)
- Possible horizontal scroll bar issues on XP when using the Light theme fixed
- Improved error checking and handling when reading from damaged devices
